10360|54d735c8.name: Kergul Bloodaxe
10360|54d735c8.text: $N, the Silverwing Sentinels must be crushed!  Are you ready for Warsong Gulch?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

263647|53fff4bc.name: Borook Gallfist
263647|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

3084|2d9bad33.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|2d9bad33.text: And to which battleground do you wish to journey?

3084|aa7b3716.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|aa7b3716.text: Such needless strife, but if the elves of Silverwing Hold will not speak to us in peace, then what alternative do they leave us? Seek out the aid of Kergul Bloodaxe on the Hunter Rise to get to Warsong Gulch.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|8fd1ef50.name: Urtharo
3314|8fd1ef50.text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

3373|43457c57.name: Arnok
3373|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5882|8fca8484.name: Pephredo
5882|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5882|f341dff7.name: Pephredo
5882|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5885|f341dff7.name: Deino
5885|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5958|6e89a35a.name: Thuul
5958|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7427|090f8855.name: Taim Ragetotem
7427|090f8855.text: Our forces in Alterac Valley need wisdom to achieve victory $c.  You look like the one to lead them.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1944-progress.name: Deino
1944-progress.text: I am pleased you have returned with your skin intact, $N.  Do you have the water sample?  I am eager to study its properties.
1944-progress.title: Waters of Xavian

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
